first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports simplifying onboarding and reducing signup friction. This directly addresses both current problems while avoiding promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention. A small guarded test should measure completion, activation, qualified revenue, and retention before broader rollout.

final.rationale: Run a segmented simplification experiment for SMB and simple-workspace accounts, where prior evidence shows improved activation and onboarding completion. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because shortened onboarding increased 60-day churn there. Track onboarding completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and retention; expand only if downstream quality remains healthy.
